criteria.deficiency: Non-blocking: mode handling is internally inconsistent for 'tr'. Validation normalises the mode by sorting it (generated/rich/progress.py:1246-1247) and applies text-mode rules to it (1260-1263), but the return test compares the raw mode (1276), so 'tr' returns a binary reader. The candidate's test tests/test_progress.py:749-756 locks in this binary result. The reference has the same behaviour (reference/rich/progress.py:1237-1238, 1249, 1270), so this is not a regression against the reference, but builtin open treats 'tr' as text (CPython parses mode characters in any order; this is from knowledge of CPython, not executed).
